snippet.title: Castlevania The Arcade (2009) 4K/60FPS Full Game ENGLISH ALL SOUNDS WORKING! Konami LongPlay
snippet.description:
Full playthrough of Castlevania the arcade game for your viewing enjoyment, rendered in 4k, audio and text in English with all sound effects working, no graphics glitches on the last level!  This game looks pretty good in 4k, especially the last boss battle! If you enjoy arcade game playthrough videos in 4k, hit the sub button! I left the attract mode in because it's got the story intro in it... so watch the intro short story part before the gameplay. 

I managed to fight the werewolf and the mask lady twice in this run through. Not sure if there's any other bosses I missed?

This was a pretty rare arcade game before this release, big thanks to everyone who was involved in preserving this one and tinkering to get it running. Video Game Esoterica, Argon etc. This game is awesome.... you need a fast cpu and gpu to run it well, if you have slower hardware you'll get more lag in the controls and it makes it way harder to play. The more responsive your mouse inputs are, the more accurate you can play.
